why_not_higher_tier: ICES/NAFO assessments are stock-scale and lagged; this observatory has no validated current-condition grid or short-horizon forecast. Do not treat trawl CPUE as a census.
known_limitations: OBIS count is compiled records, effort-biased, mixed methods. Surface SST is not bottom thermal habitat. No T3/T4/T6 product.

marine_estuarine_freshwater: marine; anadromous freshwater stages out of ocean models unless partitioned
stock_or_population_unit: not_partitioned; ESA ESUs exist and must not be mapped at capture resolution
why_not_higher_tier: Commercial W2 is unresolved and is a 24-48h encounter product research, not a T3/T4 observatory model. PFMC assessments are annual. Juvenile chlorophyll papers are the wrong stage. Individual archival tags exist in literature but are not ingested here (no T5).
known_limitations: Mixed stocks in CA/OR ocean catch. SST is a surface proxy for ~8-12C habitat not abundance. AIS is not fish. Do not emit listed-ESU targeting layers.

marine_estuarine_freshwater: marine, brackish (WoRMS also notes broader environment flags; models must declare salinity domain)
why_not_higher_tier: Farmed lease occupancy is OPERATIONALLY OBSERVED by the operator, not a global T5 layer. No observatory 24-72h stress model is published. WA DOH growing-area class is food-safety geography not oyster stress. Do not treat introduced-culture presence as wild census.
known_limitations: Industry and many agencies still say Crassostrea gigas; join both AphiaIDs. Portuguese oyster is a different taxon. Aerial heat x tide is not SST. Larvae are a separate T0 row.

why_not_higher_tier: Mytilus species complex and hybridization (edulis/trossulus/galloprovincialis) confound occurrence. No observatory current biomass product. Intertidal presence in OBIS is not a standing stock.
known_limitations: Name used loosely in some datasets. Habitat envelope is intertidal/shallow subtidal filter-feeding; not a nowcast.

stock_or_population_unit: not_partitioned; ASMFC GOM/GBK vs SNE are management stocks not extra species
why_not_higher_tier: Ventless-trap and assessment indices are seasonal/stock scale not next-trip T3/T4. CPUE is catchability-confounded. Satellite SST is a poor substitute for bottom temperature (ASMFC 2025 peer review cited in commercial dossier). No T5 trap-sensor ingest here. Do not map right whales.
known_limitations: Landings are not biomass. Pelagic larvae are a separate T0 row. Exact string locations NEVER_PUBLISH.

why_not_higher_tier: Continuous Plankton Recorder and similar surveys are lagged and route-biased. Chlorophyll is not Calanus abundance. No observatory time-aware basin nowcast.
known_limitations: Key prey for some fish and right whales; do not publish products that function as whale-finding aids. Morphological confusion with sibling Calanus possible in some datasets.

why_not_higher_tier: Reef association supports T2 habitat, not current reef-fish abundance. Visual census programs exist regionally but are not ingested or validated here as T3.
known_limitations: Diver survey effort concentrates on accessible reefs. Coral loss can decouple historical habitat maps from current occupancy.

principal_synonym: WoRMS also lists alternative representation AphiaID 145795
why_not_higher_tier: Regional seagrass maps exist but are not a global T3 canopy nowcast operated by this observatory. Do not treat presence of a meadow polygon as fish abundance.
known_limitations: AphiaID 495077 accepted vs 145795 alternative representation; join both. Optical satellite seagrass mapping is site-limited and optically constrained.

why_not_higher_tier: Some regional Landsat/Sentinel kelp-canopy products are REMOTELY DETECTED surface canopy, not global species biomass and not an observatory T3. Subsurface sporophytes are not seen from space.
known_limitations: OBIS n is large and likely includes dense monitoring programs; still effort-biased. Canopy ≠ whole-plant carbon. Storm loss can be faster than map latency.

why_not_higher_tier: Not upgraded to T2 this pass: no habitat-envelope URL was verified beyond WoRMS/OBIS metadata. ICCAT assessments are not a spatial nowcast. Electronic tags exist externally (no T5 ingest).
known_limitations: Highly migratory; occurrence records track fleets and surveys. Spawning areas are sensitive. Vessel density is not tuna abundance.

why_not_higher_tier: Public T2 habitat surfaces can act as finding aids. Acoustic/satellite tagging programs exist externally; observatory has not ingested tracks so T5 is not assigned. Individual ≠ population.
known_limitations: Opportunistic sightings and cage-dive effort bias. IUCN spatial downloads not used. Do not publish aggregation sites.

why_not_higher_tier: Occurrence relatively sparse at global grain. Cleaning-station and aggregation sites are NEVER_PUBLISH. CITES-listed; no T2 public suitability product this pass.
known_limitations: Must join Manta birostris records. Photo-ID catalogs are not a census. Satellite sightings of rays are not demonstrated as operational T5 for this observatory.

why_not_higher_tier: OBIS metadata n=176 is too thin for a defensible global habitat model this pass. Range expansions in the literature are hypotheses, not T3.
known_limitations: Fishery-dependent observations dominate. Diel vertical migration means surface fields miss daytime depth. Not abundance from night-light vessel maps.

why_not_higher_tier: O. vulgaris is a species complex in modern systematics; occurrence under this name is not a single biological population. No verified habitat envelope URL this pass.
known_limitations: Do not pool worldwide 'vulgaris' records into one suitability model without taxonomic review.

why_not_higher_tier: Evidence ceiling capped at T1 for public products: feeding/breeding locations and tracks are NEVER_PUBLISH at useful finding resolution. PAM and satellite tags exist externally (no T5 ingest). VHR satellite detections remain research-grade and are not a census.
known_limitations: WoRMS also has an unaccepted Balaenoptera musculus AphiaID 380449 pointing at B. physalus; use 137090 only. Do not use AIS as whale abundance.

why_not_higher_tier: High OBIS n could support T2 scientifically; public assigned tier is T1 because fine habitat surfaces are bycatch/finding risks. Aerial/acoustic surveys are not an observatory T3 nowcast.
known_limitations: Harbour vs harbor spelling. Static-gear bycatch sensitivity. Do not publish real-time porpoise maps.

why_not_higher_tier: Satellite telemetry programs exist (STAT/SWOT and others) but are not ingested; T5 not assigned. Nesting beaches NEVER_PUBLISH. Habitat suitability would be T2-eligible scientifically but is capped at T1 public this pass.
known_limitations: WoRMS class field may be empty; order Testudines. Do not interpolate a few tracks into population density.

why_not_higher_tier: At-sea occurrence is T1. Colony coordinates and nest counts are not observatory public layers. Tracking studies exist externally (no T5).
known_limitations: Ship-follower and colony-adjacent effort bias. Ocean-associated only; not a terrestrial bird product.

principal_synonym: Emiliania huxleyi (Lohmann) W.W.Hay & H.Mohler, 1967 AphiaID 115104 unaccepted
why_not_higher_tier: Ocean-color bright waters can be REMOTELY DETECTED bloom signals, not a species census and not uniquely this taxon. Not upgraded to T3. Always join Emiliania huxleyi records.
known_limitations: Accepted name Gephyrocapsa huxleyi on WoRMS 2026-09-18. Satellite PIC/hue is not cell counts. Many OBIS records may still be filed under the synonym.

why_not_higher_tier: Aurelia is a cryptic species complex; 'aurita' records are not one population. Bloom reports are opportunistic. No T2 envelope verified this pass.
known_limitations: Citizen and stranding records biased to coasts. Ephyrae unobserved in most datasets.

why_not_higher_tier: Remaining colony coordinates are NEVER_PUBLISH (ESA listed). Historical occurrence is T1. Do not publish a 'where to find elkhorn' suitability map.
known_limitations: Historical range includes extirpated sites; using them as current habitat is false. Disease and bleaching dynamics are not a 72h observatory forecast.

why_not_higher_tier: No verified quantitative habitat-envelope source this pass. Barrens vs kelp state is ecological context, not T3 density.
known_limitations: Dive and dredge effort bias. Larvae not in this row.

scientific_authority: Chisholm, Frankel, Goericke, Olson, Palenik, Waterbury, West-Johnsrud & Zettler, 1992
why_not_higher_tier: Oceanographic textbooks describe oligotrophic gyre habitat, but this registry does not treat uncited expert lore as T2. Flow-cytometry/molecular detections are sample-scale (1), not a global cell nowcast (4).
known_limitations: Ecotype diversity below species rank. Pigment/ocean-color is not species ID. OBIS n under-represents true occupancy.

why_not_higher_tier: OBIS metadata n=2. Hadal camera/lander observations exist in papers but are not a compiled occurrence layer usable for range. Real-time tracking of all individuals is capability (7).
known_limitations: Type-locality science is not a survey time series. Do not draw a trench-wide density map.

why_not_higher_tier: OBIS n=37 is insufficient for coarse global/seasonal range under this framework. Media bloom reports are not a standardized survey (would still be T1 if compiled with dates/places under rights review).
known_limitations: East Asian coastal blooms are real phenomena; this observatory does not have a lawful compiled series ingested. Do not equate fishing-forum photos with abundance.

why_not_higher_tier: WoRMS status is unavailable name (Candidatus). OBIS n=18. Molecular oceanography describes ubiquity; that is not a georeferenced occurrence cube in this registry. Continuous global mapping would require new molecular observing infrastructure (4).
known_limitations: Do not treat an unavailable Candidatus name as a fully available species. eDNA/16S detections are not a census.

why_not_higher_tier: Adult OBIS n is not larval n. Larval settlement and OA-sensitive veligers are not spatially inventoried at observatory scale. Particle-tracking of larvae is MODEL-INFERRED/HYPOTHETICAL, not T1 larval occurrence. Commercial W1 explicitly excludes hatchery larvae unless the operator is a hatchery.
known_limitations: Do not copy adult T2 onto larvae. Aragonite saturation is first-order for this stage, not for 72h farmed adults. Same AphiaID as OBS-TAX-003 by design.
